name: training_free_second_checkpoint_v1
purpose: Test whether the corrected training-free retrofit extends from Gemma-3-4B-PT to a larger pretrained checkpoint without changing the recipe or confirmation cohort.

technical_fallback_model.role: Use only if the primary 12B run fails for an objective technical reason before metrics are observed; retain the raw-token protocol and label the result as same-scale instruction-tuning sensitivity.

primary_endpoints: ungrafted and grafted strict admission counts over all eight records
fixed-C_b feasibility count over all eight records

reporting_policy.token_hash_mismatch: Retain the result, disclose the mismatch, and do not claim identical token blocks across scales.

execution_policy: Run 12B-PT first. Do not invoke the 4B-IT fallback because the 12B metrics are unfavorable. A fallback is permitted only after an objective model-load, architecture, memory, or runtime failure that occurs before primary outcomes are available.
